free_tier.stated: Plans scale up to 16 TB of storage.

per_object_cap.notes: The page states no per-file size limit; the stated plan ceiling is 16 TB of storage.

retention.notes: The page states a 7-day money-back guarantee on VPS and Storage plans and names no retention period for stored files. The terms page states unpaid services are terminated three days past the due date and active data and backups are destroyed.

egress.terms: Bandwidth scales to 5x storage: 16TB plan = 80 TB/mo; 1TB plan = 5 TB/mo. Byte cap, not unmetered. Page footer claims "10 Gbps Connectivity".
